requirements: R1: Patch task status reconciliation to accurately detect PRs closed without merge and update task status atomically

slices.title: Patch PR closed-without-merge reconciliation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR closed event handler for this epic, I want to accurately map the closed-without-merge state and apply atomic updates, so that the internal task status correctly reflects the failure.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR payload indicating closure without merge
When the event is processed
Then the system must atomically update the task status using a WHERE clause on the previous status
Given the epic has 1 requirement and is in the clear domain
When the implementation is completed
Then QA is verified directly via unit and integration tests covering the PR closed-without-merge state transition.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce mismatch of unmerged PR task statuses to 0 occurrences
